name: Glamev AI Catalog Image Studio for WooCommerce
author: Glamev

sections.description:
Glamev AI Catalog Image Studio for WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store to the Glamev SaaS platform for AI-powered product image editing, background removal, lifestyle scene generation, and pushing updated images back into your store automatically.

Unlike server-side alternatives that require a VPS, SSH access, and Python installation, Glamev runs entirely in the cloud. No server configuration. No SSH. Works on shared hosting, managed WordPress, and any standard WooCommerce setup.

What you can do with Glamev:

  • Remove product image backgrounds with AI
  • Generate lifestyle scenes around your products
  • Create shadow effects and color variants
  • Produce wearable/model images for fashion products
  • Batch-process entire product catalogs

How the plugin works:

  1. Install and activate — the plugin creates a secure API key automatically.
  2. Copy your Store URL and API Key from WooCommerce > Glamev.
  3. Add your store in the Glamev dashboard.
  4. Browse your WooCommerce products inside Glamev, select images, and apply AI edits.
  5. Approved images are automatically pushed back to the product’s featured image and gallery in WooCommerce.

Privacy and data:

Product data and image URLs are only shared with Glamev when you initiate a sync from the Glamev dashboard. No data is sent automatically in the background. This plugin requires a Glamev account.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Glamev SaaS:

  • Service URL: https://glamev.com
  • When data is sent: only when the store owner initiates a sync from the Glamev dashboard.
  • What data is sent: product data and product image URLs needed to browse products and process images.
  • What comes back: processed product images. With your instruction from the Glamev dashboard, these are either added to an existing product’s gallery, uploaded to your WordPress media library so you can use them later, or used to create a new draft product. Created products are always drafts and are never published automatically.
  • Background transmission: none. The plugin does not automatically send product data in the background.

Service policies:

  • Terms of Service: https://glamev.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://glamev.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the glamev-ai-catalog-image-studio-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Glamev in the WordPress admin.
  4. Copy your Store URL and API Key.
  5. In the Glamev dashboard, go to Stores and add your WooCommerce store using those values.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Glamev account?

Yes. The plugin is a connector for the Glamev SaaS and requires a Glamev account.

Does this work on shared hosting?

Yes. All AI processing runs in Glamev’s cloud. No VPS, SSH access, or server configuration is required.

What data is shared with Glamev?

Glamev receives product data and image URLs only when you start a sync from the Glamev dashboard. Processed images are then pushed back to the WooCommerce product you selected.

Is data sent automatically in the background?

No. This plugin does not automatically transmit product data in the background.

Is the plugin free?

The WordPress plugin is free. Glamev account usage, credits, or subscription pricing are managed through Glamev.

What kinds of image workflows does this support?

Background removal, lifestyle scene generation, shadow effects, color variants, and model/wearable images for fashion products.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Changed: plugin slug renamed to glamev-ai-catalog-image-studio-for-woocommerce to comply with WordPress.org’s WooCommerce trademark naming policy.

1.1.0

  • Added: push Glamev images straight to your media library, for products you have not created yet.
  • Added: create a draft WooCommerce product from Glamev images, with the featured image and gallery already set.
  • Changed: products and images created by the plugin are now attributed to the administrator who generated the API key.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.

The Glamev dashboard: available credits, images processed, connected stores, and active batches at a glance.
Set up a wearable shot — choose a model from the ethnicity and gender presets, pick the poses to generate, and see the credit cost before the batch runs.
Brand Assets and watermarking: set the watermark text, position, opacity, and scale, with a live preview on a sample product.
Archives keeps every past batch, showing the operations applied, images generated, and credits spent.
